text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk Manhattan Cafe back to the
dorms, just as
the sun begins to set.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Are you free after this?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Then... would you mind waiting for me at
the
park?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's a picnic table in the back... If we
sit
there... I don't think anything will
bother us...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll get everything ready and then head
over... See
you soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Manhattan Cafe runs off
to the
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is there something she wants to discuss
with me?
Well, either way, I should head
for the park.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm waiting at the picnic table for
Manhattan
Cafe, when...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn around to see her standing with a
large bag
in her hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sets the bag down on the table,
then takes
out its contents and lines
them up one by one.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Everything's ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several insulated jugs now sit on the
table, along
with a stack of paper cups.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Coffee. I brewed it all myself...
choice_data_list: What in the world is this...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The coffee in this jug has a light, acidic
taste...
And the one next to it has a
deeper, aromatic
taste...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This one has a fruity sweetness to it...
That one
has a balance of acidity and
bitterness...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: You prepared so much for us.
You prepared so much for us, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Which would you like to drink?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Do any of them stand out to you? Does
one look
more delicious than the others?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She questions me with a long,
unwavering gaze. I
can't put my finger
on why, but I feel immense
pressure.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: I'd like to try Cafe's favorite flavor.
Might as well drink the whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What I like... isn't important right now,
so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm... sorry about that... I was being a
little pushy
there...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I was just... curious is all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to know your tastes... Your
favorite type
of coffee...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But... I couldn't think of any other way to
find
out...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come to understand why she made so
many
different blends of coffee for me.
With that in
mind...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, let's share what we each like.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you... very much. Let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, under the night sky and
surrounded by
Manhattan Cafe's
thoughtfully prepared coffee,
we share
our favorite flavors with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our chat keeps my heart warm long after
the
coffee has cooled.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's not a good idea... You'll get a

stomachache...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Coffee is delicious... but you can have
too much
of a good thing...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've done it before, so I try to be more
careful
now... You should too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: Still, Cafe brewed this especially for me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I appreciate the thought, but also...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I was being a little pushy
there...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I was just... curious is all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to know your tastes... Your
favorite type
of coffee...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But all I've done is... trouble you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come to understand why she made so
many
different blends of coffee for me.
With that in
mind...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: In that case, let's share what we each like.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you... very much. Let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, under the night sky and
surrounded by
Manhattan Cafe's
thoughtfully prepared coffee,
we share
our favorite flavors with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking my time so as not to get a
stomachache, I
savor each coffee and
feel warmed to the core by
this tasting
session.
